links.outcome: Concordance of AI treatment recommendations with tumor board decisions on local historical patients
links.quote: The concordance rate between the AI and MTB was 86.96%.

links.outcome: Factors (age, performance status, stage) affecting AI-tumor board concordance across patient subgroups
links.effect: Age (p=0.000), performance status 1-3 (p=0.003, 0.007, 0.000), and stage IV (p=0.017) significantly affected concordance; stage IV concordance was 45.83%.
links.quote: In the multivariate analysis, age (p-value = 0.000), performance status (p-value = 0.003 for performance score 1; p-value = 0.007 for performance score 2; p-value = 0.000 for performance score 3), and stage IV (p-value = 0.017) had a significant effect on concordance between the MTB and WFO.

screen.reason: Retrospective concordance study comparing Watson for Oncology recommendations against real multidisciplinary tumor board decisions for gastric cancer patients.
